ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the measures being taken to prevent it
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What measures are being taken to prevent it?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased accountability in the Medicaid system.
